characters.name: Elena Voss
characters.description: Mother searching for the truth on the Salt Coast

events.description: Elena and Mara enjoy a sunny morning at the beach, collecting shells. The village looks peaceful and inviting in the early light.
Nessa greets Elena at the market, hinting at strange tides. A sense of underlying mystery starts to seep into the routine.
Mara wanders near the treacherous cliffs and slips, almost falling into the roaring sea below. Elena rescues her just in time.
Elena confronts Petra Mallow about the crumbling cliff paths. Petra dismisses her concerns, suggesting some paths are meant to be forgotten.
Kade Finn helps Mara fix her broken shell necklace. The two share a lighthearted exchange that breaks the growing tension.
Elena visits the lighthouse to ask Dorian Salt about the cliffs. There is an unspoken, slightly suggestive history between them.
Nessa tells Kade about The Watcher, an old village legend. The wind howls, making the tale feel all too real.
Mara discovers a hidden cave entrance beneath the lighthouse. She finds old journals that mention her mother's name.
Elena catches Mara in the cave. A heated argument leads to a shocking revelation: Dorian Salt is Elena's father.
events.spoiler_reason: Reveals key plot twist or identity

events.description: The village gathers as a storm approaches. Petra attempts to maintain order while murmurs of the revealed secret spread.
Dorian speaks to the village, revealing the darkest secret: the missing child from decades ago was never lost, but hidden by Petra.
events.spoiler_reason: Reveals key plot twist or identity

events.description: The storm breaks. Elena and Mara stand together on the beach, looking toward a future free of lies. The lighthouse beam sweeps over them.

protected_facts: Dorian Salt is Elena's biological father
The missing child was never lost
